name: ImageFilledBestsellers
job: Rank best sellers as horizontal bars filled with each product's photo, where bar length shows units sold, so a ranking doubles as a product lineup
visitor_action: hover or tap a bar to see units sold and the product name (shown on the big hanging tag); arrow keys move between bars
mobile: bars become full-width rows with photo thumbnails, a slim photo-filled bar under each name, counts at the end
motion: bars grow left to right in a stagger with the photo revealed behind a glowing moving edge, then price tags drop in on a spring; the big tag swings when the selection changes (reduced-motion: full bars, static tags, simple fade)
art_direction: Market stall: warm kraft background, photo-filled bars with rounded ends, tomato-red rank numbers, handwritten-feel price tags
